pages.title: Mycelium Bed
pages.text: A tray of damp substrate under a misting hood, threaded with white fungal threads that feel their way to food.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Set the moisture and the temperature. Growth peaks at the mould's temperature and wants moisture, and must reach the recipe's share of its best. Over 95% moisture, bacteria take the bed.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Antibiotic, Mould Culture, Network Map, Physarum Culture.
